recommendations.title: Increase water intake frequency (every 15-20 minutes if outdoors)
recommendations.rationale: HeatLens score 60.8 (High, uncalibrated), driven by WBGT (Humidity) — dehydration risk rises with either heat load.
recommendations.basis: NIOSH Heat Stress: Hydration fact sheet (2017): 1 cup (8 oz) of water every 15-20 minutes when working in the heat

hap_trigger_basis: White - No Alert: city max temperature 35.0 C (Open-Meteo forecast) against AMC thresholds (Yellow >= 41.1 C, Orange >= 43.1 C, Red >= 45.0 C; AMC Heat Action Plan 2019 (Easy Read), section IV.A 'Color Signals for Heat Alert', p.3). Context, not used for the level: HeatLens thermal-stress band High; published-heatwave exposure tier below_threshold.

health.source: de Bont et al., Environ Int 2024;184:108461 (PMC11790314)

cap_preview.headline: AMC White - No Alert - Isanpur, 2026-10-01
cap_preview.description: HeatLens score 60.8 (High), regime MODERATE, dominant driver WBGT (Humidity). Uncalibrated HeatLens composite index - not a validated health-outcome forecast.
